rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an ordinary piece of stone or stone used as a material.

example.english: This stone is very heavy, and I can't move it.
example.traditional: 呢塊石頭好重，我搬唔郁。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 sek6 tau4 hou2 cung5 ngo5 bun1 m4 juk1

rows.note: Use this for a gemstone or precious stone in general, rather than specifically a diamond.

example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 bou2 sek6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for the diamond slice of the gemstone sense.

example.english: This stone is a real diamond.
example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 zyun1 sek6 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the British weight unit of fourteen pounds.

example.english: This sack of wool weighs three stone.
example.jyutping: ni1 doi6 joeng4 mou4 zung6 saam1 jing1 sek6
